foundation.description: Ekdum shunya se shuru karein. Hum fikar karne wale academic concepts ko chhod kar seedha sikhenge ki Python actual me memory, state aur logic ko kaise chalaata hai. Aap memory ko live bante dekhenge.

beginner.description: Ab time hai asli engineering habits banane ka. Hum explicitly trace karenge ki loops, functions aur arrays hood ke andar kaise chalte hain taaki aap sirf andeje se scripts na likhein.

intermediate.audience: Scripts aur apps banane wale builders
intermediate.description: Apne logic toolkit ko upgrade karein. Hum dictionaries, stacks, queues aur classic search algorithms me deep dive karenge. Ye aapke har production backend ke building blocks hain.

advanced.audience: Problem solving refine karne wale engineers
advanced.description: Algorithmic thinking shuru karein. Dekhein kaise recursion stack banata hai, real-time me sort hotey dekhein aur finally samjhein ki actual server par Big O matters kyu theek hai.

mastery.description: The deep end. Ab scripts chodiye systems banana sikhiye. Un graph aur dynamic programming pattern ko master karein jo Staff/Principal engineers technical interviews me maangte hain.

algorithms.hello-world: System se apka first entry point. Live dekhiye kaise print() console me data dalta hai — production me aaj tak print debugging sabse badhiya tool hai.
algorithms.variables-types: Dekhein variables RAM memory block kaise claim karte hain. ints vs floats samjhein, aur dynamically typed bhashayen kitni forgiving ho sakti hain.
algorithms.string-operations: Sach pucho toh backend me 80% kaam sirf string slicing aur parsing hi karta hai. In strings ko join karna aur substring split practically dekho.
algorithms.arithmetic: Asli logic ka flow. Dekho compiler math expression pe kitni jaldi memory operations calculate karke exact output return kardeta hai.
algorithms.if-else: Business logic ki jaan. Branching ko actual code me handle karna bohut zaroori ho jata hai taaki apke booleans ghalat authenticate na karein.
algorithms.while-loop: Execution tab tak ghumta hai jab tak condition chalo ho. Dekhein iterations guard checks mein kahan fas ke infinitely server block karti hai.
algorithms.for-loop: Array manipulation aur data processing! In collections mein hum pipelines pe iteration array objects yaha map hote dekhte hai.
algorithms.lists-basics: Python ka apna array container. Apko practically pata chalega ki bich (middle) mein push/pop karna kitna process slow down kardeta hai.
algorithms.functions-intro: Don't Repeat Yourself (DRY) block ka standard. Call stack allocates frames memory clear karke execution pause karta return bhejta hai.
algorithms.input-output: Sync input operations user ko block karte hai. Pata chalega ki Type casting (int) strings par kitni important error prevention technique hai.
algorithms.linear-search: Har element iterate karne wali brute force. Par chote arrays lists prod me array linear search completely O(n) fine rehta hia.
algorithms.count-occurrences: Logs tracking. HashMap Dictionary logs frequency parsing me O(1) reads fast aggregate count increment save state mapping fast.
algorithms.find-min-max: Ek hi pass mein minimum aur maximum dono track karo. Array sort karna bilkul zaroori nahi — ek simple loop kafi hai aur CPU cycles bhi bachte hain.
algorithms.sum-average: Values accumulate karo, average nikalo. Python ka built-in sum() C-level pe optimize hai — apna manual loop use karne ki zaroorat hi nahi, yeh usse hamesha faster chalega.
algorithms.loop-explorer: Dekhein ki loop iterations shared state kaise update karte hain. Score ko har pass ke saath accumulate hote dekhein.
algorithms.reverse-list: Dono sides se two-pointer swap. Pointers ko beech mein milne tak andar move karte dekhein.
algorithms.palindrome: Dono sides se characters compare karein. Dekhein ki two-pointer technique symmetry confirm kaise karti hai.
algorithms.fizzbuzz: Classic divisibility check. 100 iterations mein modulo ko conditional output drive karte dekhein.
algorithms.factorial: 1 se n tak multiply karein. Product ko step by step badhte dekhein aur samjhein ki 0! = 1 kyun hai.
algorithms.fibonacci-iterative: Do rolling variables ke saath sequence generate karein. Dekhein ki yeh space mein recursive version ko kyun beat karta hai.
algorithms.binary-search: Har step par search space ko aadha karein. Sorted input zaroori. O(log n) ko live hote dekhein.
algorithms.selection-sort: Har pass mein minimum dhundhein aur front mein move karein. n passes ko sorted array produce karte dekhein.
algorithms.insertion-sort: Har element ko already-sorted prefix mein sahi position par insert karein. Nearly sorted data ke liye efficient.
algorithms.two-pointers: O(n²) double loop ki jagah do edge indexes ek doosre ki taraf chalao. Array problems ko linear time mein solve karo — bina extra memory kharach kiye.
algorithms.hash-map-counting: O(1) per lookup mein count karne ke liye dictionary use karein. Kai frequency problems ki foundation.
algorithms.stack-ops: LIFO action mein. List par stack ke roop mein push, pop, aur peek animate hote dekhein.
algorithms.queue-ops: FIFO action mein. Enqueue aur dequeue animate hote dekhein aur samjhein ki deque list se better kyun hai.
algorithms.anagram-check: Kya do strings ek dusre ki rearrangements hain? O(n) mein character counting se solve karte dekhein.
algorithms.sliding-window: Size k ki har window mein maximum sum dhundhein. Window ko array par slide karte dekhein.
algorithms.merge-sorted: Do sorted arrays ko ek mein combine karein. Merge sort ke peeche ka core operation.
algorithms.bubble-sort: Adjacent pairs compare karo, bade elements har pass mein bubble up hote hain. Production mein kabhi mat lagana — lekin loop invariants aur boundary conditions samajhne ka ye sabse easy entry point hai.
algorithms.merge-sort: Divide karo, dono halves sort karo, merge karo. Recursion tree ko split aur recombine hote live dekhein. Stable aur guaranteed O(n log n) — koi worst case nahi.
algorithms.quick-sort: Ek pivot choose karo, uske around partition karo, recurse karo. Average O(n log n) ke saath amazing cache performance — lekin galat pivot choose karo toh O(n²) ka khatara pakka hai.
algorithms.heap-sort: Max-heap banayein, elements ko order mein extract karein. Quicksort ke unlike guaranteed O(n log n).
algorithms.bfs: Queue use karke graph ko level by level explore karein. Unweighted graphs mein shortest paths dhundhein.
algorithms.dfs: Backtracking se pehle jitna deep ho sake explore karein. Har recursive step ke saath call stack badhte dekhein.
algorithms.binary-tree-traversal: In-order, pre-order, post-order. Ek hi tree par nodes ko different sequences mein visit hote dekhein.
algorithms.two-sum: Do numbers dhundhein jo target mein add hote hain. Dekhein ki hash map O(n²) ko O(n) mein kaise badalta hai.
algorithms.valid-parentheses: Open aur close brackets match karne ke liye stack use karein. Classic stack application interview question.
algorithms.fibonacci-recursive: Call tree ko exponentially fan out hote dekhein. Samjhein ki memoization kyun zaroori hai.
algorithms.dijkstra: Priority queue use karke source se sabhi nodes tak shortest paths dhundhein. GPS navigation ki backbone.
algorithms.knapsack: Weight limit ke andar value maximize karein. DP table ko row by row bharte dekhein.
algorithms.lcs: Do strings mein shared sabse lamba subsequence dhundhein. Diff tools aur DNA alignment ka core.
algorithms.topological-sort: Dependencies respect karte hue tasks ko order karein. Kahn's algorithm ko zero in-degree nodes hataate dekhein.
algorithms.kruskals: Cycles banaye bina lowest-weight edges ko greedily add karke minimum spanning tree banayein.
algorithms.trie: Letter by letter strings insert aur search karein. Dekhein ki autocomplete under the hood kaise kaam karta hai.
algorithms.floyd-warshall: 3-loop DP ke saath all-pairs shortest paths. O(V³) mein distance matrix update hote dekhein.
algorithms.segment-tree: O(log n) mein range queries aur point updates. Tree build aur sums upar propagate hote dekhein.
algorithms.coin-change: Ek amount banane ke liye minimum coins. DP array ko 0 se target tak bharte dekhein.
algorithms.bit-manipulation: AND, OR, XOR, shifts — cryptography, graphics, aur competitive programming ke peeche ke operations.

hello-world.title: Knowledge Check
hello-world.question: `प्रिंट()` फ़ंक्शन क्या करता है?

options.A: कंसोल पर डेटा आउटपुट करता है

hello-world.successMessage: Bilkul sahi! `print()` hi vo tool hai jo state console pe dikhata hai. Senior log bhi debug karne ke liye isko hi daily use karte hain.

variables-types.title: Knowledge Check
variables-types.question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक पूर्णांक चर बनाता है?
variables-types.successMessage: सही! 5 बिना उद्धरण या दशमलव के एक पूर्णांक है।

string-operations.title: Knowledge Check
string-operations.question: Python mein do strings ko join karne ke liye kaun sa operator use hota hai?
string-operations.successMessage: Sahi baat! `+` operator strings ko concatenate karta hai. Yaad raho — integer ko string mein seedha add mat karna, pehle str() mein convert karo warna TypeError aayega.

arithmetic.title: Knowledge Check
arithmetic.question: Modulo operator (%) kya return karta hai?
arithmetic.successMessage: Sahi hai! % remainder calculate karta hai.

if-else.title: Knowledge Check
if-else.question: Python mein alternate condition ke liye kaun sa keyword use hota hai?
if-else.successMessage: Correct! Python mein 'elif' use karte hain.

while-loop.title: Knowledge Check
while-loop.question: Agar while loop ki condition kabhi False na ho, toh kya hoga?
while-loop.successMessage: Bilkul sahi! Infinite loop chalata rehta hai bina ruke.

for-loop.title: Knowledge Check
for-loop.question: for loop mein numbers pe iterate karne ke liye kaun sa built-in function use karte hain?

lists-basics.title: Knowledge Check
lists-basics.question: List 'arr' ke pehle element ko access kaise karein?

functions-intro.title: Knowledge Check
functions-intro.question: Function define karne ka keyword kya hai?

input-output.title: Knowledge Check
input-output.question: input() hamesha kaun si type return karta hai?
input-output.successMessage: Bilkul sahi! int() se convert karo.

linear-search.title: Knowledge Check
linear-search.question: Linear Search ki worst-case time complexity kya hoti hai?
linear-search.successMessage: Sahi! Linear Search har element check karta hai — worst case O(n) hota hai.

count-occurrences.title: Knowledge Check
count-occurrences.question: 'Count occurrences' kya karta hai?

options.A: Count karta hai ki ek value list mein kitni baar aayi
options.B: List ko frequency se sort karta hai

count-occurrences.successMessage: Bilkul sahi! Yeh har value ki occurrence count karta hai.

find-min-max.title: Knowledge Check
find-min-max.question: Minimum aur Maximum dono dhundhne ke liye list ko kitni baar traverse karna hoga?
find-min-max.successMessage: Correct! Ek traversal mein hi dono track ho jaate hain.

sum-average.title: Knowledge Check
sum-average.question: Python mein list ke saare elements ka sum return karne wala built-in function kaun sa hai?
sum-average.successMessage: Bilkul sahi! sum(list) ek call mein saare elements add karta hai.

loop-explorer.title: Knowledge Check
loop-explorer.question: Python mein loop ko turant khatam karne ka keyword kya hai?
loop-explorer.successMessage: Sahi! 'break' loop ko immediately end karta hai.

reverse-list.title: Knowledge Check
reverse-list.question: Python mein arr[::-1] kya return karta hai?
reverse-list.successMessage: Sahi! Slice [::-1] kisi bhi sequence ko reverse kar deta hai.

palindrome.title: Knowledge Check
palindrome.question: Palindrome string...

options.A: Sirf aage se padhi jaati hai
options.B: Sirf peeche se padhi jaati hai
options.C: Aage aur peeche dono taraf se same padhi jaati hai
options.D: Alphabetical order mein padhi jaati hai

palindrome.successMessage: Bilkul sahi! 'racecar' dono directions se same hai.

fizzbuzz.title: Knowledge Check
fizzbuzz.question: FizzBuzz mein 3 aur 5 dono se divisible number pe kya print hota hai?
fizzbuzz.successMessage: Sahi! Dono se divisible numbers ke liye 'FizzBuzz' print hota hai.

factorial.title: Knowledge Check
factorial.question: 0! (zero factorial) ki value kya hai?
factorial.successMessage: Correct! Convention ke mutabik 0! = 1 (empty product) hota hai.

options.A: Pichle number ka double hota hai
options.B: Pichle do numbers ka sum hota hai
options.C: Pichle number se 1 zyada hota hai
options.D: Pichle number ka square hota hai

binary-search.title: Knowledge Check
binary-search.question: Binary Search apply karne se pehle array ke baare mein kya sach hona chahiye?
binary-search.successMessage: Bilkul! Binary Search ke liye sorted array chahiye taaki search space half ho sake.

selection-sort.title: Knowledge Check
selection-sort.question: Selection Sort ke har pass mein kya hota hai?

options.A: Sabse bada element end mein jaata hai
options.C: Minimum element dhundh ke aage swap kiya jaata hai

selection-sort.successMessage: Sahi! Har pass minimum dhundh ke sorted boundary pe rakhta hai.

insertion-sort.title: Knowledge Check
insertion-sort.question: Insertion Sort kab sabse zyada efficient hota hai?
insertion-sort.successMessage: Bilkul! Almost sorted input mein kam insertions chahiye — best case O(n) hota hai.

two-pointers.title: Knowledge Check
two-pointers.question: Sorted array two-pointer problem mein agar sum bahut bada ho toh kya karein?

options.A: Left pointer ko right ki taraf move karo
options.B: Right pointer ko left ki taraf move karo
options.C: Dono pointers ko andar ki taraf move karo

two-pointers.successMessage: Sahi! Right pointer left move karne se sum kam hota hai.

hash-map-counting.title: Knowledge Check
hash-map-counting.question: Hash Map lookup ki average time complexity kya hoti hai?
hash-map-counting.successMessage: Ekdum sahi! Dictionary O(1) average lookup deti hai — nested double loop se permanently chutkara. Frequency problems mein hash map ek real game changer hai.

stack-ops.title: Knowledge Check
stack-ops.question: Stack mein pehle kaun sa element remove hota hai (LIFO principle)?

options.C: Sabse baad mein add kiya gaya element

stack-ops.successMessage: Sahi! LIFO — Last In, First Out.

queue-ops.title: Knowledge Check
queue-ops.question: Queue mein pehle kaun sa element serve hota hai (FIFO principle)?

options.A: Sabse baad mein add kiya gaya element

queue-ops.successMessage: Bilkul! FIFO — First In, First Out.

anagram-check.title: Knowledge Check
anagram-check.question: Do strings anagram hoti hain agar woh...

options.A: Same characters same order mein contain karein
options.B: Same characters kisi bhi order mein contain karein
options.C: Alag characters hoon par same length ho

anagram-check.successMessage: Sahi! Anagrams mein identical characters hote hain, bas reorder kiye hue.

sliding-window.title: Knowledge Check
sliding-window.question: Sliding Window technique time complexity ko...se reduce karti hai
sliding-window.successMessage: Bilkul! Window O(n) mein slide karta hai, har baar fresh calculate nahi hota.

merge-sorted.title: Knowledge Check
merge-sorted.question: Size m aur n ke do sorted arrays merge karne mein...time lagta hai
merge-sorted.successMessage: Sahi! Dono arrays ka har element exactly ek baar visit hota hai — O(m + n).

bubble-sort.title: Knowledge Check
bubble-sort.question: Bubble Sort ke ek complete pass ke baad kya guaranteed hota hai?

options.B: Sabse bada unsorted element apni final position pe hai

bubble-sort.successMessage: Sahi! Har pass current maximum ko uski final position pe le jaata hai.

merge-sort.title: Knowledge Check
merge-sort.question: Merge Sort ki saare cases mein time complexity kya hai?
merge-sort.successMessage: Bilkul! Merge Sort hamesha divide aur merge karta hai — O(n log n) guaranteed.

quick-sort.title: Knowledge Check
quick-sort.question: Quick Sort ki worst-case time complexity kya hai?
quick-sort.successMessage: Sahi! Kharab pivot choice se worst case O(n²) ho sakta hai.

heap-sort.title: Knowledge Check
heap-sort.question: Heap Sort kis data structure pe depend karta hai?
heap-sort.successMessage: Bilkul! Heap Sort max-heap banata hai, phir elements ko sorted order mein nikalta hai.

counting-sort.title: Knowledge Check
counting-sort.question: Counting Sort kis type ke input ke liye best hai?
counting-sort.successMessage: Sahi! Counting Sort bounded range mein integers ke liye optimal hai.

recursion-basics.title: Knowledge Check
recursion-basics.question: Recursive function ko infinite run hone se kaun rokta hai?
recursion-basics.successMessage: Bilkul! Har recursive function mein rukne ke liye base case zaroori hai.

dp-basics.title: Knowledge Check
dp-basics.question: Dynamic Programming subproblems ko dobara calculate karne se bachne ke liye kaun si technique use karta hai?
dp-basics.successMessage: Sahi! DP solved subproblem results ko store karta hai reuse ke liye.

bfs.title: Knowledge Check
bfs.question: BFS nodes ko level-by-level explore karne ke liye kaun sa data structure use karta hai?
bfs.successMessage: Bilkul! BFS Queue (FIFO) use karta hai nodes ko discovery order mein process karne ke liye.

dfs.title: Knowledge Check
dfs.question: DFS naturally (recursively) kaun sa data structure use karta hai?
dfs.successMessage: Sahi! DFS pehle deep jaata hai, backtracking ke liye stack use karta hai.

binary-tree-traversal.title: Knowledge Check
binary-tree-traversal.question: Kaun sa traversal order Left → Root → Right nodes visit karta hai?
binary-tree-traversal.successMessage: Sahi! BST ka In-order traversal nodes ko ascending order mein deta hai.

two-sum.title: Knowledge Check
two-sum.question: Two Sum ko O(n) time mein solve karne ke liye kaun sa data structure kaam aata hai?
two-sum.successMessage: Spot on! Hash Map mein thoda RAM invest karo aur O(n²) brute force se hamesha ke liye chutkara pao. FAANG interviews mein yahi approach expect ki jaati hai.

valid-parentheses.title: Knowledge Check
valid-parentheses.question: Valid Parentheses solve karne ke liye kaun sa data structure use hota hai?
valid-parentheses.successMessage: Sahi! Stack opening brackets track karta hai aur closing brackets se match karta hai.

fibonacci-recursive.title: Knowledge Check
fibonacci-recursive.question: Naive recursive Fibonacci (memoization ke bina) ki time complexity kya hai?
fibonacci-recursive.successMessage: Bilkul! Call tree har level pe double ho jaata hai — exponential O(2ⁿ).

dijkstra.title: Knowledge Check
dijkstra.question: Dijkstra's algorithm ke sahi results dene ke liye kya zaroori hai?

options.C: Saare edge weights non-negative hone chahiye

dijkstra.successMessage: Sahi! Dijkstra negative weights pe fail karta hai; Bellman-Ford use karo.

bellman-ford.title: Knowledge Check
bellman-ford.question: Bellman-Ford ka Dijkstra ke muqable mein kya advantage hai?

options.C: Negative edge weights ko sahi se handle karta hai

bellman-ford.successMessage: Bilkul! Bellman-Ford edges ko V-1 baar relax karta hai aur negative weights handle karta hai.

knapsack.title: Knowledge Check
knapsack.question: 0/1 Knapsack problem kis technique se solve hota hai?
knapsack.successMessage: Sahi! DP optimal subproblem solutions ki table banata hai.

lcs.title: Knowledge Check
lcs.question: LCS ka full form kya hai?
lcs.successMessage: Bilkul! LCS dono strings mein same order mein aane wali sabse lambi sequence dhundta hai.

topological-sort.title: Knowledge Check
topological-sort.question: Topological sort sirf kis type ke graph pe apply hota hai?
topological-sort.successMessage: Sahi! Cycles topological order ko impossible bana dete hain; sirf DAGs sort ho sakte hain.

kruskals.title: Knowledge Check
kruskals.question: Kruskal's algorithm kya dhundta hai?

options.A: Do nodes ke beech shortest path

kruskals.successMessage: Bilkul! Kruskal greedily sabse sasti edge add karta hai jo cycle na banaye.

trie.title: Knowledge Check
trie.question: Trie data structure sabse zyada kisliye use hota hai?

options.C: Prefix-based string search aur autocomplete ke liye

trie.successMessage: Sahi! Tries strings ko prefix se store karte hain jisse fast prefix searches hoti hain.

floyd-warshall.title: Knowledge Check
floyd-warshall.question: Floyd-Warshall kya calculate karta hai?
floyd-warshall.successMessage: Bilkul! Floyd-Warshall O(V³) mein saare node pairs ke beech shortest paths dhundta hai.

segment-tree.title: Knowledge Check
segment-tree.question: Segment Tree kaun si time complexity mein range queries support karta hai?
segment-tree.successMessage: Sahi! Range queries aur point updates dono O(log n) mein run hote hain.

coin-change.title: Knowledge Check
coin-change.question: Coin Change (minimum coins) solve karne ka best tarika kya hai?
coin-change.successMessage: Bilkul! DP 0 se target tak har amount ke liye minimum coins ki table fill karta hai.

bit-manipulation.title: Knowledge Check
bit-manipulation.question: x XOR x hamesha kya deta hai?
bit-manipulation.successMessage: Sahi! Koi bhi number apne aap se XOR karne par hamesha 0 deta hai.
